core_claim: A cell may be marked directionally regular only if one fixed unit direction d has a conservative whole-cell bound with inf <grad f(x), d> > 0 or sup <grad f(x), d> < 0.
forbidden_inferences: global topology from directional regularity alone
shipping proof from ordinary float64 arithmetic

candidate_direction_policy.primary: normalized direct center gradient, used only to propose d and never as proof
candidate_direction_policy.near_zero_center_gradient_tiny: may return UNKNOWN; no invented direction

ladder.C1_0: semantic contract plus analytic exact-derivative fixtures
ladder.C1_1: conservative directional-derivative range engine for the frozen triplane+LayerNorm+SiLU field
ladder.C1_2: adversarial critical/fold/tangent fixtures with zero false regularity
ladder.C1_3: numeric margin and exact-backend binding audit; ordinary float64 remains research-only
ladder.C1_4: frozen Knight paired handoff: primary 19 d8/m2 C0 ZERO_OR_UNKNOWN cells; stress all 32 NEAR_ZERO cells
ladder.C1_5: closure decision before any full-domain certified traversal or extractor promotion

c1_4_metrics.surface_ready_metric: Regularity is not itself terminal. For a certified direction, opposite-face sign bounds may be combined with monotonicity in a later crossing proof.

before_full_domain: estimate surface-cell population from existing sign-change/MC evidence
project traversal cost with measured near-zero boxes per cell and measured per-box latency
batch/vectorize range evaluation if projected runtime is excessive

demo_priority: C1 research must not destabilize the existing demo/product path; all work remains isolated on the research branch.
